description: This source file defines the MainTabs widget, which provides a bottom navigation bar for switching between primary feature pages such as Tasks, Projects, Tags, Dashboard, and Settings. It also manages the app's main scaffold structure and facilitates interaction with the TasksPage via a custom notification for the FAB button.

classes.name: MainTabs
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages bottom navigation across main feature pages.

classes.name: _MainTabsState
classes.description: State class for MainTabs, managing current tab index and UI rendering.

classes.name: _TabInfo
classes.description: A simple class holding information about a tab: title, icon, and content widget.

classes.name: _ComingSoon
classes.description: A StatelessWidget displaying a 'coming soon' message for features not yet implemented.

classes.name: TasksFabTapNotification
classes.description: A Notification class to signal a tap on the FloatingActionButton, used to trigger actions in TasksPage.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for MainTabs.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the MainTabs, including Scaffold, AppBar, body, FAB, and BottomNavigationBar.

methods.name: _tabs
methods.description: Returns a list of _TabInfo objects representing each tab.
